title: Servers in Helsinki
summary: Choose Helsinki for your Matrix computer, and invite people to apps more easily.

highlights.title: Helsinki server location
highlights.body: When you set up Matrix, you can now place your computer in Helsinki.

items.text: Sharing an app is compact and starts with an invite.
Matrix OS Canary can be installed next to the stable desktop app.
Browsing public sites in Full Access mode is steadier.
